studies.notes: Read the whole saved markdown, including both appendices, and checked the cited PDF pages with pymupdf. The paper prints enrolled/randomized headcounts but no explicit analyzed-person total or analyzed-person counts by arm or AI-only contrast. No participant exclusion count or final participant-flow statement is printed. Assignment counts were not substituted for analyzed headcounts, and no headcounts were calculated from teams, mean team sizes, or outputs. Other_counts labels the printed units; these are not alternative S1 headcounts. The expanded model reuses Experiment I teams; whether Experiment II individuals previously participated in Experiment I is unstated. The external OSF supplement linked in PDF p. 8, footnote 3 remains unverified: urllib requests with User-Agent atlas-screening/0.1 to the named supplement page, its OSF API files endpoint, and the named preregistration all failed with WinError 10013 (socket access forbidden). The absence of an explicit analyzed-person count is established only for the saved PDF. Quotes normalize whitespace and omit the page header interrupting the analysis sentence.
